system.description:
A thin, cold-to-the-touch tome bound in white ermine over white pine, sealed with a tarnished silver clasp. While it's in your possession, you have Immune: Cold.

A spellcaster who spends a Shift studying the Codicil learns the Frostburn Spell (if they don't already know it). Bound within its pages is also a poem, "Rime of the Frostmaiden" - an incantation whose true power is tied to a specific place and moment (GM's discretion).
system.lore: Written by Auril's own priesthood as a primer on her worship, its silver-gilt pages describe rites better left un-performed.
